item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Provides a complete offline `DummyLM` program with signature, metric, dataset, one valid completion, one malformed completion, and a call to `bootstrap_trace_data`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `raise_on_error=False`, then accesses `rows[1]` and prints row types, demonstrating the malformed case is kept in returned rows rather than dropped."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Identifies the bad row as `FailedPrediction` and asserts `completion_text == \"not json at all\"`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Prints the failed row trace length and asserts `len(rows[1][\"trace\"]) > 0`, confirming trace data is preserved."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Inspects `bad.format_reward` and asserts it is not `None` as the score-like field on the failed parse."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
